name: Shenzhen Everbest Machinery Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Everbest Machinery Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, marketing, and sale of test and measurement instruments and meters in China and internationally. It offers new energy products, thermal imagers, infrared thermometers, digital multimeters, laser distance meters, electrical testers, digital clamp meters, coating thickness meters, dataloggers, environment test meters, video borescopes, automotive digital multimeters, medical instruments, and accessories, as well as body thermometers, temperature and humidity meters, moisture meters, light meters, sound level meters, anemometers, gas detectors, and particle counters …
